_meanings:
(Mostly used as a prefix to verbs and nouns, rarely as
 an adverb or preposition.) It is used in the following senses (according to <ls>G. M.</ls>):--
.²1 Lowness, downward motion (‘down’, ‘under’, ‘below’); {#nipat nizad#}.
.²2 A group or collection; {#nikara, nikAya#}.
.²3 Intensity; {#nikAma, nigfhIta#}.
.²4 Command, order; {#nideSaH#}
.²5 Continuance, permanence; {#niviSate#}.
.²6 Skill; {#nipuRa#}.
.²7 Restraint, confinement; {#nibanDa#}.
.²8 Inclusion (‘into’, ‘in’); {#nipItamudakam#}.
.²9 Proximity, nearness; {#nikawa#}.

.²10 Insult, wrong, harm; {#nikfti, nikAra#}.
.²11 Showing; {#nidarSana#}.
.²12 Cessation; {#nivft#}.
.²13 Resort, refuge; {#nilaya#}.
.²14 Doubt.
.²15 Certainty.
.²16 Affirmation.
.²17 Throwing, giving <ab>&c.</ab> (according to Durgādāsa).
.²18 {#nimicCatinirmicCati#} To perform Nīrājana or the ceremonial waving
 of lights round an object of worship or an idol; also round a person or
 horses or elephants as an auspicious act; {#kurute tameva nimicCapa devaH#}
 {#saPalaM sa janma#} <ls>N. 7. 43</ls>.
